tools.description: Download a file from a specified Dropbox path, requiring the files.content.read scope, and return downloadable content and file metadata. Bursty reads may trigger HTTP 429; honor the Retry-After header.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: The path to search in Must be a canonical Dropbox path from `path_display` or `path_lower` in API results — hand-typed paths frequently cause not-found or 409 errors. Paths in shared/team folders may become invalid if items are moved or access is revoked.

tools.name: Remove file member
tools.description: Remove a specified member from a file's sharing permissions; inherited access may remain. Some access or member errors are returned in the response rather than raised, and this endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: File from which to remove members. Use the file ID in the format 'id:...' or the file path.

inputs.name: member
inputs.about: Member to remove from this file. Specify either by email or dropbox_id.

tools.name: Remove File Properties
tools.description: Tool to permanently remove specified property groups from a file or folder. Use when you need to delete custom properties associated with a file.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: A unique identifier for the file or folder. This can be a path (e.g., '/test_properties_file.txt') or a file ID.

inputs.name: property_template_ids
inputs.about: A list of identifiers for property templates to remove from the file. These are template IDs created by templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team. Use an empty list to remove all property groups.

inputs.name: Dropbox-API-Select-User
inputs.about: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

tools.name: Remove file properties template for team
tools.description: Tool to remove a property template from a team. Use when you need to delete a file properties template that was previously added to the team.

inputs.name: template_id
inputs.about: An identifier for a template created by templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team. Format: ptid:XXXX

tools.name: Remove tag from file or folder
tools.description: Tool to remove a tag from a file or folder in Dropbox. Use when you need to delete or untag an existing tag from an item. The tag will be removed only if it exists on the specified path.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: Path to the file or folder to remove the tag from. Must start with a slash.

inputs.name: tag_text
inputs.about: The tag to remove. Will be automatically converted to lowercase letters by Dropbox.

inputs.name: Dropbox-API-Select-User
inputs.about: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

tools.name: Remove folder member
tools.description: Removes a user or group from a shared folder, identified by email or Dropbox ID. An owner or editor can request removal; the response may include an asynchronous job ID for checking completion.

inputs.name: member
inputs.about: The member to remove from the shared folder. Can be identified by email address or Dropbox ID

inputs.name: leave_a_copy
inputs.about: If true, the removed user will keep their copy of the folder after it's unshared (if mounted). Otherwise, it will be removed from their Dropbox. Must be false when kicking a group

inputs.name: shared_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID for the shared folder from which to remove the member

tools.name: Remove group members
tools.description: Tool to remove members from a Dropbox team group. Use when you need to remove one or more users from a team group. Requires team admin permissions.

inputs.name: group
inputs.about: The group from which users will be removed. Specify either by group_id or group_external_id

inputs.name: users
inputs.about: List of users to be removed from the group. Each user can be identified by team_member_id, external_id, or email

inputs.name: return_members
inputs.about: Whether to return the list of members in the group after removal. Note that setting this to true may take a long time for large groups. Default is false

tools.name: Remove sharing allowlist
tools.description: Tool to remove domains or email addresses from the team sharing allowlist. Use when team admins need to revoke approval for specific domains or emails. Requires team admin authentication. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided, with a maximum of 1000 entries per call. Entries must already exist on the allowlist.

inputs.name: emails
inputs.about: List of email addresses to remove from the allowlist. Each email must be a valid string representation following RFC-5322/822 (e.g., 'user@example.com'). Entries must already exist on the allowlist. Maximum 1000 entries per call. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided

inputs.name: domains
inputs.about: List of domains to remove from the allowlist. Each domain must be a valid string representation following RFC-1034/5 (e.g., 'example.com', 'subdomain.example.org'). Entries must already exist on the allowlist. Maximum 1000 entries per call. At least one of 'domains' or 'emails' must be provided

tools.name: Remove team member custom quota
tools.description: Tool to remove custom storage quota for team members, reverting them to the team's default quota. Use when you need to reset storage limits for specific team members. Requires team admin credentials.

inputs.name: users
inputs.about: List of users to remove custom quota from. Each user must be identified by exactly one of: team_member_id, external_id, or email. Maximum of 1000 users per request

tools.name: Remove member space limits excluded users
tools.description: Tool to remove users from the member space limits excluded users list. Use when you need to re-enable space limits for specific team members. Maximum of 1000 users per request. Requires team admin credentials.

inputs.name: users
inputs.about: List of users to be removed from the excluded users list. Maximum of 1000 users per request

tools.name: Rename team folder
tools.description: Tool to rename an existing team folder in Dropbox. Use when you need to update the name of a team folder.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the team folder.

inputs.name: team_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team folder to rename. You can get this from list team folders action.

tools.name: Resend secondary email verification
tools.description: Tool to resend secondary email verification emails to team members. Use when team members need verification emails resent for their secondary email addresses. Requires team admin credentials.

inputs.name: emails_to_resend
inputs.about: Collection of users paired with secondary emails needing verification resent. Each item contains the user identifier and list of secondary email addresses

tools.name: Restore file to specific revision
tools.description: Tool to restore a specific revision of a file to the given path in Dropbox. Use when you need to revert a file to a previous version using its revision identifier.

inputs.name: rev
inputs.about: The revision to restore for the file. This is a unique identifier for a specific version of the file.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: The path to the file you want to restore in the user's Dropbox. Path is case-sensitive.

tools.name: Revoke shared link
tools.description: Tool to revoke a Dropbox shared link. Use when you need to remove access to a file or folder by disabling its shared link. Note that revoking a direct link to a file may not fully prevent access if parent folders have active shared links.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The URL of the shared link to revoke. Can be any valid Dropbox shared link URL. Note: After revoking a link, the file may still be accessible if there are shared links to parent folders.

tools.name: Save copy reference
tools.description: Tool to save a copy reference to the user's Dropbox. Use when you have a copy reference (obtained from copy_reference/get) and need to save it to a specific destination path.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination where the referenced file or folder will be saved. This path is case-sensitive and must start with '/'.

inputs.name: copy_reference
inputs.about: A copy reference returned by copy_reference/get. This is an opaque string that can be used to save a file or folder to the user's Dropbox.

tools.name: Save file from URL
tools.description: Save a file to Dropbox directly from a public URL via server-side fetch. The save may complete immediately or run asynchronously; by default the tool polls for up to 120 seconds, or it can return the job ID without waiting.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The URL to be saved. Must be a valid, publicly accessible URL.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: The path in Dropbox where the URL will be saved to (including filename). Must start with a slash.

inputs.name: wait
inputs.about: If true, poll the job status until completion or timeout. If false, return the async_job_id immediately.

inputs.name: timeout_seconds
inputs.about: Maximum time in seconds to wait for job completion when wait=true. Ignored if wait=false.

inputs.name: Dropbox-API-Select-User
inputs.about: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

tools.name: Continue Dropbox Search
tools.description: Tool to fetch the next page of search results from a previous Dropbox search. Use when you have a cursor from a search operation and need to retrieve additional results. Note: search along with search_continue can only retrieve a maximum of 10,000 matches total.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: The cursor returned by your last call to search or search_continue. Used to fetch the next page of results.

tools.name: Search File or Folder
tools.description: Search Dropbox files and folders by name or content, optionally scoped to a path, with cursor pagination. Check has_more and continue with the cursor, and verify result paths and types before acting; newly indexed items may take time to appear, and results are limited to items visible to the authenticated user.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The search string. Must be 1 or more non-whitespace characters. Queries are case-insensitive. Required unless cursor is provided.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor from a previous search response for fetching the next page of results. When provided, all other parameters are ignored and the continue endpoint is called.

inputs.name: options
inputs.about: Additional options for the search. If not provided, default search options will be used. Key sub-fields: `path` (must start with '/' or use 'id:...' format; omit to search entire account, narrow to reduce noise); `file_categories` and `file_extensions` to filter by type; no native date-range filter

inputs.name: match_field_options
inputs.about: Options for match field highlighting. If not provided, default options will be used.

inputs.name: Dropbox-API-Select-User
inputs.about: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

tools.name: Search File Properties
tools.description: Tool to search across property templates for particular property field values. Use when you need to find files or folders that have specific custom property values (e.g., find all files with priority='high'). Note: This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor returned by a previous properties/search response. When provided, the action calls properties/search/continue and ignores queries/template_filter.

inputs.name: queries
inputs.about: List of queries to search. Required unless cursor is provided. Each query specifies a property field value to search for and the field name to search within.

inputs.name: template_filter
inputs.about: Filter results to contain only properties associated with specific template IDs.

tools.name: Send team member welcome email
tools.description: Tool to send a welcome email to a pending team member. Use when a team admin needs to resend or send a welcome email to a user who has been invited to the team.

inputs.name: .tag
inputs.about: Type of identifier to use: 'team_member_id' for team member ID, 'external_id' for external ID, or 'email' for email address

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Email address of the user. Required when tag is 'email'

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.about: External ID of the user. Required when tag is 'external_id'

inputs.name: team_member_id
inputs.about: The team member ID of the user. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'

tools.name: Set profile photo
tools.description: Set a Dropbox account's profile photo using a base64-encoded JPEG image. With a team token, a team member can be selected for the operation.

inputs.name: photo
inputs.about: Photo data to set as the profile photo. Must be a base64-encoded JPEG image.

inputs.name: Dropbox-API-Select-User
inputs.about: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

tools.name: Set team member custom quota
tools.description: Tool to set custom storage quotas for team members in Dropbox. Use when you need to assign specific storage limits to individual team members. Maximum of 1000 users per request.

inputs.name: users_and_quotas
inputs.about: List of users and their custom quotas to set. Maximum of 1000 users per request.

tools.name: Share folder
tools.description: Tool to share a folder with collaborators in Dropbox. Most sharing will be completed synchronously, but large folders will be completed asynchronously. If an async_job_id is returned, you'll need to call check_share_job_status until the action completes to get the folder metadata. Use when you need to create a shared folder or convert an existing folder to a shared folder.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: The path to the folder to share. If it does not exist, then a new one is created. Must be a valid Dropbox path (e.g., '/TestSharedFolder').

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: A list of FolderActions corresponding to FolderPermissions that should appear in the response's SharedFolderMetadata.permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the folder.

inputs.name: force_async
inputs.about: Whether to force the share to happen asynchronously. Large folders will be completed asynchronously anyway. Set to true to make testing the async case repeatable.

inputs.name: link_settings
inputs.about: Settings that apply to a link.

inputs.name: member_policy
inputs.about: Policy governing who can be a member of a shared folder.

inputs.name: acl_update_policy
inputs.about: Who can change a shared folder's access control list.

inputs.name: shared_link_policy
inputs.about: Who can view shared links in this folder.

inputs.name: viewer_info_policy
inputs.about: Who can enable/disable viewer info for this shared folder.

tools.name: Start upload session
tools.description: Tool to start a new upload session with the given data. Use when uploading large files in multiple requests. This call starts the session and you can then use upload_session/append_v2 to add more data and upload_session/finish to complete the upload. A single request should not upload more than 150 MiB.

inputs.name: close
inputs.about: If true, the current session will be closed after uploading this data, at which point you won't be able to call upload_session/append_v2 anymore with the current session. Set to false to keep the session open for appending more data.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: File data to upload in this initial session.

tools.name: Start batch of upload sessions
tools.description: Tool to start a batch of upload sessions. Use when you need to upload multiple large files and want to initialize multiple upload sessions at once. Each session can then be used with upload_session/append_v2 to upload file chunks and upload_session/finish_batch to complete the uploads.

inputs.name: num_sessions
inputs.about: The number of upload sessions to start. Must be between 1 and 1000.

inputs.name: session_type
inputs.about: Type of upload session. 'sequential' means pieces of data are uploaded sequentially one after another (default). 'concurrent' means pieces of data can be uploaded in concurrent RPCs in any order.

tools.name: Unlock multiple files
tools.description: Tool to unlock multiple files at specified paths in a single batch operation. Locked files can only be unlocked by the lock holder or a team admin (for business accounts). Returns metadata for each unlocked file or error details for failures.

inputs.name: entries
inputs.about: List of files to unlock. Each entry contains a path or file ID. Duplicate paths are processed only once.

tools.name: Unmount shared folder
tools.description: Tool to unmount a shared folder for the current user. Once unmounted, the shared folder will be removed from the user's Dropbox. Use when a user wants to remove a shared folder from their Dropbox while remaining a member of the folder.

inputs.name: shared_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the shared folder to unmount.

tools.name: Unshare file
tools.description: Tool to remove all members from a Dropbox file. Use when you need to revoke access for all collaborators on a file. Note: This does not remove inherited members from parent folders and does not support apps with the app folder permission.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: The file to unshare. Use the file ID format (e.g., 'id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAABJA') or a path to the file. This action removes all members from the file, but does not remove inherited members from parent folders.

tools.name: Unshare folder
tools.description: Tool to allow a shared folder owner to unshare the folder. Use when you need to stop sharing a folder with all members. Unshare will not work if: the shared folder contains shared folders OR the shared folder is inside another shared folder. You must call check_job_status with the returned async_job_id to determine if the action completed successfully. Requires sharing.write scope.

inputs.name: leave_a_copy
inputs.about: If true, members of this shared folder will get a copy of this folder after it's unshared. Otherwise, it will be removed from their Dropbox. The current user, who is an owner, will always retain their copy. Default is false

inputs.name: shared_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID for the shared folder to unshare. You can get this from list_shared_folders action

tools.name: Update file member
tools.description: Tool to change a member's access level on a shared file. Use when you need to update permissions for an existing file member (e.g., change from editor to viewer or vice versa). Note: This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: File for which to update the member's access. Can be a file path (e.g., '/test_read_file_basic.txt') or file ID (e.g., 'id:xxxxx').

inputs.name: member
inputs.about: The member whose access to update. Identify by email or Dropbox ID.

inputs.name: access_level
inputs.about: The new access level for the member. 'viewer' - The member can only view the file. 'editor' - The member can edit the file. Note: Editor access may fail with no_permission for certain file types.

tools.name: Update file properties
tools.description: Tool to update custom properties on a file or folder in Dropbox. Use when you need to modify metadata fields associated with a property template, such as updating status, priority, or other custom attributes. Requires the files.metadata.write scope.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: A unique identifier for the file or folder. Can be a path (e.g., '/test.txt') or file ID (e.g., 'id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXz').

inputs.name: update_property_groups
inputs.about: The property groups 'delta' updates to apply. Each update specifies a template ID and the fields to add/update or remove.

inputs.name: Dropbox-API-Select-User
inputs.about: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

tools.name: Update file request
tools.description: Tool to update an existing file request in Dropbox. Use when you need to modify the title, destination, deadline, open/closed status, or description of a file request.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the file request to update. Example: 'oaCAVmEyrqYnkZX9955Y'

inputs.name: open
inputs.about: Whether to set this file request as open or closed. If true, the file request will accept files. If false, it will be closed.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The new title of the file request. Must not be empty if provided.

inputs.name: deadline
inputs.about: Represents the deadline parameters when updating a file request deadline.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The new description of the file request.

inputs.name: destination
inputs.about: The new path in the user's Dropbox where uploaded files will be saved. Must be a path starting with '/'. Example: '/Homework/math'

tools.name: Update folder member
tools.description: Tool to update another member's permissions in a shared folder. Use when an owner or editor needs to change access levels for existing members. This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

inputs.name: member
inputs.about: The member of the shared folder to update. Note: Only the dropbox_id may be used for updates according to API docs, but email is also supported by the endpoint

inputs.name: access_level
inputs.about: The new access level for the member. Note: Cannot set access level to 'owner' through this endpoint

inputs.name: shared_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the shared folder containing the member to update. You can get this from list_shared_folders action

tools.name: Update folder policy
tools.description: Tool to update the sharing policies for a shared folder. Use when you need to change who can be members, who can update the ACL, viewer info settings, shared link policies, or link settings. User must have AccessLevel.owner access to the shared folder.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: A list of FolderActions corresponding to FolderPermissions that should appear in the response's SharedFolderMetadata.permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the folder

inputs.name: link_settings
inputs.about: Settings that apply to a link.

inputs.name: member_policy
inputs.about: Policy governing who can be a member of a shared folder.

inputs.name: shared_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID for the shared folder. You must have AccessLevel.owner access to update its policies

inputs.name: acl_update_policy
inputs.about: Who can change a shared folder's access control list (ACL).

inputs.name: shared_link_policy
inputs.about: Policy governing who can view shared links.

inputs.name: viewer_info_policy
inputs.about: Policy governing who can view viewer information.

tools.name: Set group member access type
tools.description: Tool to change a member's access type in a team group. Use when you need to promote a member to owner or demote an owner to regular member. Requires team admin permissions with group management capabilities.

inputs.name: user
inputs.about: The user whose access type will be changed. Must be an existing member of the group. Can be identified by team_member_id, external_id, or email

inputs.name: group
inputs.about: The group containing the member whose access type will be changed. Specify either by group_id or group_external_id

inputs.name: access_type
inputs.about: The new access type to assign to the user in the group

inputs.name: return_members
inputs.about: Whether to return the list of members in the group after updating. Note that the default value will cause all group members to be returned, which may take a long time for large groups

tools.name: Update Paper Document
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Dropbox Paper document with new content in Markdown, HTML, or plain text format. Use when you need to modify, append, prepend, or overwrite content in an existing Paper doc. This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: Path to the existing Paper doc in Dropbox to update. MUST include the .paper extension at the end (e.g., '/My Documents/Notes.paper').

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Content to add or replace in the Paper document based on the update policy.

inputs.name: import_format
inputs.about: Format of the provided content: plain_text, markdown, or html.

inputs.name: paper_revision
inputs.about: The paper revision number. Required when doc_update_policy is 'update'. This value must match the current revision of the doc or an error will be returned.

inputs.name: doc_update_policy
inputs.about: Policy for updating the document: 'append' adds content to the end, 'prepend' adds content to the beginning, 'overwrite' replaces all content, 'update' merges content intelligently (requires paper_revision).

tools.name: Update property template for team
tools.description: Tool to update a property template for a team in Dropbox. Use when you need to modify an existing template's name, description, or add new property fields. Requires team admin permissions and a Dropbox Business account.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: A display name for the template. Template names can be up to 256 bytes. If not provided, the name will not be changed.

inputs.name: add_fields
inputs.about: Property field templates to be added to the group template. There can be up to 32 properties in a single template.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description for the template. Template descriptions can be up to 1024 bytes. If not provided, the description will not be changed.

inputs.name: template_id
inputs.about: An identifier for template added by templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team. Typically in the format 'ptid:XXXXX'.

tools.name: Update team folder sync settings
tools.description: Tool to update the sync settings on a team folder or its contents in Dropbox. Use when you need to control whether a team folder or specific content within it is synchronized to members' devices. This is useful for managing storage space and controlling access to sensitive content.

inputs.name: sync_setting
inputs.about: The sync setting to apply to the team folder. Possible values: 'default' (sync normally), 'not_synced' (do not sync)

inputs.name: team_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team folder to update sync settings for. You can get this from list_team_folders or other team folder operations

inputs.name: content_sync_settings
inputs.about: Optional list of content-specific sync settings within the team folder. Each entry specifies a file or folder ID and its desired sync setting

tools.name: Update team group
tools.description: Tool to update a team group's name, external ID, and/or management type. Use when you need to modify group properties such as renaming a group or changing how it's managed.

inputs.name: group
inputs.about: Specify the group to update by either group_id or group_external_id.

inputs.name: new_group_name
inputs.about: The new name for the group. If not provided, the group name remains unchanged.

inputs.name: return_members
inputs.about: Whether to return the list of members in the response. Note that the default will cause all group members to be returned, which may take a long time for large groups.

inputs.name: new_group_external_id
inputs.about: The new external ID for the group. If not provided, the external ID remains unchanged. Set to empty string to clear the external ID.

inputs.name: new_group_management_type
inputs.about: The management type for the group.

tools.name: Set team member admin permissions
tools.description: Tool to update a team member's admin permissions. Use when you need to grant or revoke admin privileges for team members. Requires team admin permissions to execute.

inputs.name: user
inputs.about: Identity of the team member whose admin permissions will be set. Use exactly one of team_member_id, email, or external_id to identify the user

inputs.name: new_role
inputs.about: The new admin permissions role to assign to the team member

tools.name: Set team member profile
tools.description: Tool to update a team member's profile information. Use when you need to change a team member's email, name, external ID, or directory restrictions. At least one profile field must be provided for update.

inputs.name: user
inputs.about: Identity of user whose profile will be set. Exactly one of team_member_id, email, or external_id must be provided to identify the user account

inputs.name: new_email
inputs.about: New email for member

inputs.name: new_surname
inputs.about: New surname for member

inputs.name: new_given_name
inputs.about: New given name for member

inputs.name: new_external_id
inputs.about: New external ID for member

inputs.name: new_persistent_id
inputs.about: New persistent ID. This field only available to teams using persistent ID SAML configuration

inputs.name: new_is_directory_restricted
inputs.about: New value for whether the user is a directory restricted user

tools.name: Set team member profile photo
tools.description: Tool to update a team member's profile photo. Use when you need to set or change the profile picture of a team member. Requires team admin permissions and a JPEG image (minimum 128x128 pixels) in base64 format.

inputs.name: user
inputs.about: The team member whose profile photo should be updated.

inputs.name: photo
inputs.about: The photo data to be set as the team member's profile photo.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Uploads a file (up to ~150 MB) to a specified path in the user's Dropbox, with options for handling existing files. Files larger than 150 MB require a chunked upload approach.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.about: Specifies how to handle the upload if a file already exists at the specified path.

inputs.name: mute
inputs.about: If true, the user will not be notified of the new file via desktop or mobile notifications.

inputs.name: path
inputs.about: Path in the user's Dropbox to save the file.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: File to be uploaded; supports various formats including images, PDFs, and text files. Ensure the content is the intended file and not an HTML/XML error page from the source server.

inputs.name: autorename
inputs.about: If true and a file already exists at the path, the new file will be renamed to avoid conflict.

inputs.name: strict_conflict
inputs.about: If true, the upload will be rejected if the file already exists, regardless of the autorename setting.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (email, name) of the connected Dropbox account.
